about_desc: Dalel Libya is a comprehensive app that brings together what citizens and small and large traders in Libya need: Libyan apps on Google Play, government and banking websites, stores, jobs, hotels, currency and gold prices, news, weather, prayer times, maps and emergency numbers.
about_f1: More than 100 Libyan apps with a direct download or Google Play search link.
about_f2: Official Central Bank rates, parallel market and gold prices.
about_f3: A moving news ticker from several Libyan and international sources with automatic updates.
about_f4: Hotel directory by city and region with maps and verified numbers.
about_f5: A map of all Libyan cities and search for services near you.
about_f6: Weather for all cities, prayer times and emergency numbers.
about_f7: Content updates automatically without having to update the app every time.
developer_desc: Developed by HASSADI. Find our other apps and contact options on the developer page.
privacy_intro: We respect your privacy. This policy explains what the "Dalel Libya" app does with information.
p_data_b: The app does not require an account and does not ask for your name, phone number or email, and it does not request location (GPS) permission. We do not collect your personal data on our own servers.
p_local_t: What is stored on your device?
p_local_b: Only your preferences are stored on your device: selected city, favorites, theme, language, the last fetched data for offline use, and any "Add your store" requests you wrote. You can delete them by clearing the app data in your phone settings.
p_third_b: To show live data the app connects to public services, including: the Central Bank of Libya, Ean Libya, gold-api.com, Open-Meteo, Aladhan, Google News and news websites, OpenStreetMap for the map, and a content file hosted on GitHub. These parties may see your device IP address according to their own policies.
p_links_b: When you tap a link or button, the destination opens in your browser, Google Play, Google Maps or the phone app. These parties are independent, have their own policies, and we do not control their content.
p_form_b: The data you type in the form is stored on your device and is sent only when you choose to send it by email or copy and share it.
p_ads_b: The app may show limited ads from the Unity Ads network: a small banner at the bottom of some screens and a rare short ad between navigations; no ads appear on the emergency and prayer-times screens. Unity may collect the advertising ID and technical device information under its own policy (unity.com/legal/privacy-policy). You can turn off ad personalization in your Google settings, or hide ads temporarily from the app menu. The app itself uses no analytics or tracking tools.
p_kids_b: The app is a general directory and does not collect data from any user, including children.
p_contact_b: We may update this policy and the last-updated date will appear above. For questions, contact us through the developer page from the menu.

libya_intro: Libya is a North African country on the Mediterranean Sea, known for its variety of coast, mountains and desert, and its ancient sites from Leptis Magna to Ghadames.
lv_area: About 1.76 million km², one of the largest countries in Africa.
lv_population: About 7 million (estimate), mostly living along the coast.
lv_neighbors: Egypt, Sudan, Chad, Niger, Algeria and Tunisia, with the Mediterranean Sea to the north.
lv_climate: Mediterranean on the coast and desert in the south; the Sahara covers most of the country.
lv_economy: Heavily based on oil and gas; Libya has some of the largest oil reserves in Africa.
lv_unesco: Leptis Magna, Sabratha, Cyrene (Shahat), the Old Town of Ghadames and Tadrart Acacus.
